Our AI Chatbot Development Services

Our chatbot development expertise is built on practical experience, not just technical capabilities. Each service we provide is supported by successful implementations for business clients. Whether you need a customer-facing virtual assistant, an HR chatbot, or a comprehensive enterprise chatbot solution, our developers have the experience to deliver solutions tailored to your requirements.
Custom AI Chatbot Development

For enterprises with specialist workflows, regulated data, or integration requirements that off-the-shelf bots can't meet. We have created bots for commodity traders, hospital triage staff, and insurance claims handlers – contexts in which having the right answer can make all the difference. Our process always begins with your data, your language, and your definition of “resolved.”
Enterprise AI Chatbot Development Services

High-volume, high-stakes deployments come with requirements most chatbot vendors gloss over: Single sign-on, role-based access, multitenancy architecture, audit logs, data residency, and zero trust. These requirements are taken as first-class requirements while building our enterprise AI chatbots and not something that is bolted on at the last minute. We have successfully implemented chatbots that handle more than 10,000 conversations a day.
Generative AI & LLM-Powered Chatbots

By leveraging Azure OpenAI, GPT-4o, and Retrieval Augmented Generation through your existing knowledgebase, we create chatbots that combine answers for you using your documentation, your contract details, and your internal policies, rather than providing matching keywords. The user experience will be totally different because users will receive detailed answers based on their queries rather than being referred to PDFs and told “Please call our helpline.”
Chatbot Integration with Business Systems

Any AI chatbot that can just do searches is basically a personified search engine. We integrate our AI chatbots straight into Dynamics 365, SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, SharePoint, and custom APIs in order for the user to be able to see the actual status of an order, create tickets, approve requests, update information, and execute workflows without ever leaving the dialogue. System integration happens in the very first development sprint.
Internal Employee AI Assistants

Queries relating to HR, IT Helpdesk, Financial Approval, Onboarding – there are about 30 to 40 repetitive questions asked by the employees each week, and answering them manually proves to be much more costly than what HR and IT managers think. We have been able to divert hundreds of internal questions from their respective departments every week using one single AI assistant in Microsoft Teams.
Chatbot Rescue & Modernisation

In case your chatbot is not performing well enough because of low resolution rates, escalation rates, and lack of trust from your customers, we will provide an honest evaluation of your chatbot. In such a way, we have worked with numerous projects provided by other companies, and we have managed to greatly increase their NPS score within a quarter of a year. It may be architecture sometimes. We will inform you of the differences and choose the most cost-effective solution for you.

Q2M's AI Chatbot Capabilities: From Conversation to Action

The AI chatbots we develop are based on many capabilities, all of which have been chosen because they solve a true business problem, and not just because they tick off items from a checklist that a software vendor supplies. Here's what powers the chatbots we build:

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) All responses are based on your own documents, SharePoint data, and knowledge bases – not a generic model’s general training. Users receive precise answers that are consistent with your current policies and products and are properly cited.

Multi-Turn Conversational Memory The chatbot is context-aware throughout the conversation – thus saving user time by eliminating repetition and processing complicated multi-stage queries in one session, instead of several.

Intent Recognition & Entity Extraction State-of-the-art NLU understands the user’s intent, extracts all the necessary information (date, order number, etc.) and appropriately routes the conversation, even when users ask questions in different ways each time.

Live System Integration & Action Chatbots can do more than answer questions — they can perform actions. Raise tickets, balance checks, schedule appointments, maintain records, and initiate approvals. They are fully traceable, trackable, and reversible when required.

Sentiment Detection & Smart Escalation When a user is frustrated or the query is genuinely beyond the chatbot's scope, the system detects this and escalates to a human with full conversation context — not a cold transfer with no history.

Multilingual Support It serves users in English, Chinese, Malay, Tamil, and other languages — with detection of the language and responses in the language the user prefers, using Azure Cognitive Services for translation.

Conversation Analytics Dashboard Every conversation is tracked, rated by resolution quality, and available in a reporting layer ready to be acted upon by your team. You know exactly what your customers are asking, how your chatbot falls short, and what needs to improve – all presented to you in clear terms rather than raw logs.

Secure-by-Design Architecture Use of Azure Private Endpoints, managed identities, RBAC for conversations, no persistent PII in the chatbot logs, full control over data residency, and built-in PDPA/GDPR compliance from the architecture stage onward.

Omnichannel Deployment Deploy to web widget, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp Business, mobile app using SDK, or a complete custom brand experience. We work where your customers already live without forcing them to alter their behaviour to talk to your chatbot.

Continuous Model Improvement Every project we work on includes a 90-day optimisation period. Real user issues expose problems testing never uncovers. Retrain, tune, and iterate. The chatbot you’ll have at 90 days will be demonstrably better than when you deployed it.

Voice-to-Text & Speech Interfaces In applications like contact centres or interactive voice response (IVR), our chatbots accept spoken input using Azure Speech Services, allowing for voice interactions in AI over the telephone using the same NLU accuracy as text.

AI Ethics & Responsible Deployment Our chatbots are designed with safeguards against generating false or dangerous information and always respond in scope. Vital in highly regulated industries where a wrong answer means something.

FAQ

a: AI chatbots refer to the computer software which is built using algorithms of artificial intelligence (AI) to emulate natural human conversation with the users. Such chatbots make use of the NLP method of computing for interpreting and responding to the inputs of users. They are capable of answering a large variety of questions, giving information, carrying out tasks, and interacting. They are used in numerous sectors as well as on numerous platforms including website, messaging applications, customer care system, and virtual assistants among others. If you wish to integrate such AI chatbots into your business process, then there is need for you to ensure that you work with experienced AI chatbot developers.

faqs.q: What are AI chatbot development services?
a: AI chatbot development services cover the end-to-end process of designing, building, training, integrating, and deploying AI-powered conversational agents for businesses. This includes everything from scoping the right use cases and selecting the AI model, to connecting the chatbot to your existing systems and supporting it post-launch. At Q2M Solutions, our custom AI chatbot development services go beyond a basic bot — we build chatbots that understand context, take real action inside your systems, and improve continuously based on real user conversations.
Conversational AI is about designing chatbots which can conduct a normal conversation just like human beings and are able to understand the context and the emotions and preferences of the users.

faqs.q: How can your AI chatbot solutions benefit my business?
a: AI chatbot solutions from Q2M Solutions are customised as per the client’s business requirement and provide numerous benefits such as quick responses, better customer engagement, round-the-clock availability, cost savings, less human error, and much more.

faqs.q: How does your AI chatbot function?
a: Our AI chatbots function based on employing NLP methods that enable understanding user input, analysing it, and creating an appropriate response. In addition, they make use of machine learning algorithms to constantly enhance themselves.

faqs.q: What are the main features of your AI chatbots?
a: The main features of our AI chatbots include round-the-clock availability, immediate feedback, personalised recommendations, ability to perform transactions, multilingualism, integration with other systems, and data analytics.

faqs.q: Why trust Q2M Solutions for building AI chatbots?
a: There are several factors that make Q2M Solutions stand out. Being a Microsoft Solutions Partner with Azure AI specialisation, we leverage the robust enterprise stack that our regulated industry customers need. Our services do not include a one-size-fits-all approach since we build a chatbot specifically for your dataset and workflows rather than using any generic platform. Moreover, we keep working with you after the project delivery by performing monitoring and model retraining regularly.

faqs.q: We already have tried using a chatbot, and it wasn’t successful. Can you help?
a: Sure! Actually, this situation is quite often encountered by our customers. At Q2M Solutions, we provide a free chatbot audit, during which we will analyse what you have, find out what exactly went wrong with the project (most likely, it’s one of the following: bad training data, lack of integration, lack of retraining, or a too ambitious scope at the beginning of the project), and suggest the best possible course of action to resolve the problem.

faqs.q: How is this different from just using Microsoft Copilot Studio ourselves?
a: Copilot Studio is an incredible platform, and we work with it quite often. However, building a high-quality, secure and reliable enterprise AI chatbot that would be integrated with your current live system, trained on your specific dataset, and would actually resolve issues is something that goes beyond the capabilities of the platform itself. We configure, tweak, integrate, and optimise what can be done via Copilot Studio, and take care of everything else that is not covered by the platform.
